# FILE: tests/runtime/test_hardware.py
================================================================================
"""Hardware as peripherals, over fakes of /dev and /sys: no real stick is opened."""

import asyncio
import json
from collections.abc import Mapping
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import pytest
from support import run, settle, state, until

from majordom_integration_sdk import Endpoint, Need, Peripheral, PeripheralChange, UsbDriver
from majordom_integration_sdk.runtime import (
    BluetoothAdapters,
    FixedPeripherals,
    FixedRadio,
    HostNetwork,
    PeripheralState,
    Pinned,
    Radio,
    RadioBusy,
    Silabs,
    UsbScanner,
)
from majordom_integration_sdk.runtime.peripherals.hardware import host, usb
from majordom_integration_sdk.runtime.peripherals.providers.ble import cpc_hci
from majordom_integration_sdk.testing import FakePeripheral, RecordingPeripheralOutput, RecordingRuntimeOutput

NCP = {"baud": 115200, "flow_control": True}  # the firmware's serial settings
SKYCONNECT = "usb-Nabu_Casa_SkyConnect_v1.0_1-if00"


class Driver(UsbDriver):
    """Recognises the sticks named in ``recognised``, with the serial settings it found them at where given, recording
    each one it opened."""

    firmwares = {
        "zigbee-ncp": [Endpoint("zigbee", "ezsp", "{device}", params=NCP)],
        "multipan-rcp": [Endpoint("multipan", "silabs-cpc", "{device}")],
    }

    def __init__(self, name: str = "silabs", **recognised: str | tuple[str, Mapping[str, Any]]):
        self.name, self.recognised, self.opened = name, recognised, []

    async def identify(self, path: str) -> str | tuple[str, Mapping[str, Any]] | None:
        self.opened.append(Path(path).name)
        return self.recognised.get(Path(path).name)


@pytest.fixture
def sticks(monkeypatch) -> dict[str, str]:
    """The sticks plugged in, by their by-id name; each is a known radio's USB id unless named "arduino"."""
    plugged: dict[str, str] = {}
    monkeypatch.setattr(usb, "_sticks", lambda: dict(plugged))
    monkeypatch.setattr(usb, "_nodes", lambda paths: dict(paths))
    monkeypatch.setattr(usb.os.path, "realpath", lambda path: path)
    monkeypatch.setattr(usb, "_usb_id", lambda path: ("1a86", "7523") if "arduino" in path else ("10c4", "ea60"))
    monkeypatch.setattr(usb, "POLL", 0.01)
    return plugged


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def held(monkeypatch) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Other programs holding a stick open, by its file name; none unless a test says so."""
    holders: dict[str, str] = {}
    monkeypatch.setattr(usb, "_holder", lambda path, is_opening_allowed=False: holders.get(Path(path).name))
    return holders


def plug(sticks: dict[str, str], *names: str):
    sticks.update({name: f"/dev/serial/by-id/{name}" for name in names})


def zigbee() -> FakePeripheral:
    return FakePeripheral("zigbee", [Need("zigbee")])


async def test_each_stick_is_a_radio_serving_what_its_firmware_does(tmp_path, sticks):
    plug(sticks, "sky")
    scanner, integration = UsbScanner([Driver(sky="zigbee-ncp")]), zigbee()
    runtime = await run(tmp_path, scanner, integration)

    [radio] = scanner.radios
    assert runtime.peripherals == [scanner, radio, integration]
    assert (radio.name, radio.driver and radio.driver.name, radio.firmware) == ("sky", "silabs", "zigbee-ncp")
    assert integration.peripherals.endpoint("zigbee") == Endpoint("zigbee", "ezsp", "/dev/serial/by-id/sky", params=NCP)
    assert runtime.users(radio) == ["zigbee"]


async def test_the_serial_settings_a_driver_found_a_stick_at_reach_its_endpoint_and_are_remembered(tmp_path, sticks):
    plug(sticks, "conbee")
    driver, integration = Driver(conbee=("zigbee-ncp", {"baud": 38400})), zigbee()
    runtime = await run(tmp_path, UsbScanner([driver]), integration)
    expected = Endpoint("zigbee", "ezsp", "/dev/serial/by-id/conbee", params=NCP | {"baud": 38400})
    assert integration.peripherals.endpoint("zigbee") == expected

    await runtime.stop()
    again, integration = Driver(conbee="zigbee-ncp"), zigbee()
    await run(tmp_path, UsbScanner([again]), integration)  # after a reboot
    assert again.opened == [] and integration.peripherals.endpoint("zigbee") == expected


async def test_only_known_radios_are_opened_until_asked(tmp_path, sticks):
    plug(sticks, "sky", "arduino")  # an Arduino resets whenever its port opens
    driver = Driver(sky="multipan-rcp", arduino="zigbee-ncp")
    scanner = UsbScanner([driver])
    runtime = await run(tmp_path, scanner)
    assert driver.opened == ["sky"]
    sky, arduino = sorted(scanner.radios, key=lambda r: r.name, reverse=True)
    assert (sky.firmware, arduino.firmware, arduino.provides) == ("multipan-rcp", None, [])

    await arduino.probe()  # the user asked: open it after all
    await settle(runtime)
    assert driver.opened == ["sky", "arduino"]
    assert arduino.firmware == "zigbee-ncp"


async def test_the_sticks_identified_and_probed_are_remembered_across_restarts(tmp_path, sticks):
    plug(sticks, "sky", "arduino")
    driver = Driver(sky="zigbee-ncp", arduino="zigbee-ncp")
    scanner = UsbScanner([driver])
    runtime = await run(tmp_path, scanner)
    await next(radio for radio in scanner.radios if radio.name == "arduino").probe()  # the user claims it
    await settle(runtime)
    await runtime.stop()
    assert driver.opened == ["sky", "arduino"]

    again, integration = Driver(sky="zigbee-ncp", arduino="zigbee-ncp"), zigbee()
    scanner = UsbScanner([again])
    await run(tmp_path, scanner, integration)  # after a reboot
    assert again.opened == []  # neither opened again
    assert {radio.name: (radio.firmware, radio.is_claimed) for radio in scanner.radios} == {
        "arduino": ("zigbee-ncp", True),
        "sky": ("zigbee-ncp", False),
    }
    assert integration.peripherals.endpoint("zigbee").url == "/dev/serial/by-id/arduino"


async def test_a_forgotten_stick_is_looked_at_again_as_one_plugged_in_anew(tmp_path, sticks):
    plug(sticks, "sky", "arduino")
    driver = Driver(sky="zigbee-ncp", arduino="zigbee-ncp")
    scanner = UsbScanner([driver])
    runtime = await run(tmp_path, scanner)
    sky, arduino = sorted(scanner.radios, key=lambda r: r.name, reverse=True)
    await arduino.probe()
    await settle(runtime)

    await sky.forget()  # a known radio's USB id: identified again
    await arduino.forget()  # one the user probed: left alone again until probed
    await settle(runtime)
    assert driver.opened == ["sky", "arduino", "sky"]
    assert (sky.firmware, arduino.firmware, arduino.is_claimed, arduino.provides) == ("zigbee-ncp", None, False, [])
    assert json.loads((scanner.platform.documents_folder(scanner) / "sticks.json").read_text()).keys() == {"sky"}


async def test_a_scan_in_flight_never_undoes_a_forget(tmp_path, sticks):
    gate = asyncio.Event()

    class Slow(Driver):
        async def identify(self, path: str) -> str | tuple[str, Mapping[str, Any]] | None:
            if Path(path).name == "a":
                await gate.wait()  # bellows resetting a stick
            return await super().identify(path)

    plug(sticks, "b")
    driver = Slow(a="zigbee-ncp", b="zigbee-ncp")
    scanner = UsbScanner([driver])
    runtime = await run(tmp_path, scanner)
    [b] = scanner.radios
    sticks.clear()
    plug(sticks, "a", "b")  # listed first: a scan now waits on its probe
    scanning = asyncio.create_task(scanner.rescan())
    await asyncio.sleep(0.01)
    shared, told = b.output, []

    class Output(RecordingPeripheralOutput):
        async def peripheral_did_change_provided(self, peripheral: Peripheral):
            told.append(peripheral)
            if len(told) == 2:  # leaving its forget, cleared
                gate.set()
                await asyncio.sleep(0.01)  # the runtime takes a moment: the scan goes on meanwhile
            await shared.peripheral_did_change_provided(peripheral)

    b.output = Output()
    await b.forget()
    await scanning
    await settle(runtime)
    assert driver.opened == ["b", "a", "b"]  # looked at again, as one plugged in anew


async def test_a_forgotten_soldered_radio_is_identified_again(tmp_path):
    (tmp_path / "ttyAMA3").touch()
    driver = Driver(ttyAMA3="multipan-rcp")
    board = FixedPeripherals(FixedRadio("mg26", str(tmp_path / "ttyAMA3"), "silabs", "zigbee-ncp"), drivers=[driver])
    runtime = await run(tmp_path, board)
    [radio] = board.provides
    assert (radio.firmware, driver.opened) == ("zigbee-ncp", [])  # as the board says

    await radio.forget()
    await settle(runtime)
    assert (radio.firmware, driver.opened) == ("multipan-rcp", ["ttyAMA3"])  # what it runs, asked


async def test_a_forgotten_soldered_radio_no_driver_tells_serves_what_the_board_says(tmp_path):
    (tmp_path / "ttyAMA3").touch()
    driver = Driver()  # it can't read it at the firmware's own serial settings
    wired = FixedRadio("mg26", str(tmp_path / "ttyAMA3"), "silabs", "multipan-rcp", {"flow_control": False})
    board, multipan = FixedPeripherals(wired, drivers=[driver]), FakePeripheral("multipan", [Need("multipan")])
    runtime = await run(tmp_path, board, multipan)
    [radio] = board.provides

    await radio.forget()
    await settle(runtime)
    assert (radio.firmware, driver.opened) == ("multipan-rcp", ["ttyAMA3"])
    assert state(runtime, multipan) == PeripheralState.RUNNING


async def test_a_stick_another_program_holds_is_left_alone_until_probed(tmp_path, sticks, held):
    plug(sticks, "sky")
    held["sky"] = "zigbee2mqtt"
    driver, integration = Driver(sky="zigbee-ncp"), zigbee()
    scanner = UsbScanner([driver])
    runtime = await run(tmp_path, scanner, integration)
    assert driver.opened == []  # never opened: probing would reset the radio under zigbee2mqtt
    assert scanner.radios[0].held_by == "zigbee2mqtt"
    assert state(runtime, integration) == PeripheralState.WAITING

    await scanner.radios[0].probe()  # the user claims it anyway
    await settle(runtime)
    assert scanner.radios[0].held_by is None
    assert state(runtime, integration) == PeripheralState.RUNNING


async def test_a_stick_is_used_once_the_other_program_lets_go(tmp_path, sticks, held):
    plug(sticks, "sky")
    held["sky"] = "node"
    scanner, integration = UsbScanner([Driver(sky="zigbee-ncp")]), zigbee()
    runtime = await run(tmp_path, scanner, integration)

    held.clear()
    await until(runtime, lambda: state(runtime, integration) == PeripheralState.RUNNING)


async def test_a_stick_held_out_of_sight_isnt_looked_at_again_and_again(tmp_path, sticks, monkeypatch):
    plug(sticks, "sky")  # its holder locked it: no open file of it can be read
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        usb, "_holder", lambda path, is_opening_allowed=False: is_opening_allowed and "another program" or None
    )
    scanner, rescans = UsbScanner([Driver(sky="zigbee-ncp")]), []

    async def rescan():
        rescans.append(scanner.radios[0].held_by)

    monkeypatch.setattr(scanner, "rescan", rescan)
    await run(tmp_path, scanner)
    assert scanner.radios[0].held_by == "another program"
    await asyncio.sleep(0.1)  # ten looks
    assert rescans == []


async def test_a_stick_plugged_in_or_out_is_followed(tmp_path, sticks):
    scanner, integration = UsbScanner([Driver(sky="zigbee-ncp")]), zigbee()
    runtime = await run(tmp_path, scanner, integration)

    plug(sticks, "sky")
    await until(runtime, lambda: state(runtime, integration) == PeripheralState.RUNNING)
    sticks.clear()
    await until(runtime, lambda: state(runtime, integration) == PeripheralState.WAITING)
    assert scanner.radios == [] and integration.calls == ["start", "stop"]


async def test_a_stick_that_comes_back_on_another_tty_is_followed(tmp_path, sticks, monkeypatch):
    """A USB bus reset re-enumerates sticks onto new ttys under the same by-id name, faster than the watcher's
    debounce: what uses it must not keep the old device node (it may be another device now)."""
    nodes = {"sky": "/dev/ttyUSB0"}
    monkeypatch.setattr(usb.os.path, "realpath", lambda path: nodes.get(Path(path).name, path))
    monkeypatch.setattr(usb, "_nodes", lambda paths: {name: nodes[name] for name in paths})
    plug(sticks, "sky")
    integration = FakePeripheral("zigbee", [Need("zigbee")])
    runtime = await run(tmp_path, UsbScanner([Driver(sky="zigbee-ncp")]), integration)
    assert integration.peripherals.endpoint("zigbee").url == "/dev/ttyUSB0"

    nodes["sky"] = "/dev/ttyUSB4"
    await until(runtime, lambda: integration.peripherals.endpoint("zigbee").url == "/dev/ttyUSB4")


async def test_a_driver_an_integration_brings_along_recognises_what_the_others_dont(tmp_path, sticks):
    class Zigpy(Driver):
        firmwares = {"deconz": [Endpoint("zigbee", "deconz", "{device}")]}

    plug(sticks, "conbee")
    zigpy = Zigpy("zigpy", conbee="deconz")
    integration = FakePeripheral("zigbee", [Need("zigbee")])
    scanner = UsbScanner([Driver()])  # the SDK's drivers know nothing of it
    runtime = await run(tmp_path, scanner, zigpy, integration)

    await until(runtime, lambda: state(runtime, integration) == PeripheralState.RUNNING)
    assert integration.peripherals.endpoint("zigbee") == Endpoint("zigbee", "deconz", "/dev/serial/by-id/conbee")
    assert zigpy.opened == ["conbee"]
    assert runtime.providers(scanner) == {"usb-driver": ["zigpy"]}

    await runtime.stop()
    sdk, again, integration = Driver(), Zigpy("zigpy", conbee="deconz"), FakePeripheral("zigbee", [Need("zigbee")])
    runtime = await run(tmp_path, UsbScanner([sdk]), again, integration)  # after a reboot
    await until(runtime, lambda: state(runtime, integration) == PeripheralState.RUNNING)
    assert again.opened == sdk.opened == []  # known from before: not opened again, also while its driver starts


async def test_one_rescan_at_a_time_opens_a_stick_once(tmp_path, sticks):
    opening: list[str] = []
    at_once: list[int] = []

    class Slow(Driver):
        async def identify(self, path: str) -> str | tuple[str, Mapping[str, Any]] | None:
            opening.append(path)
            at_once.append(len(opening))
            await asyncio.sleep(0.02)
            opening.remove(path)
            return await super().identify(path)

    plug(sticks, "conbee")
    scanner, slow = UsbScanner([Driver()]), Slow("zigpy", conbee="zigbee-ncp")
    runtime = await run(tmp_path, scanner)
    scanner.drivers.append(slow)  # as if an integration's driver got bound
    change = PeripheralChange("usb-driver", None, None)
    await asyncio.gather(scanner.needed_peripheral_did_change(change), scanner.needed_peripheral_did_change(change))
    await until(runtime, lambda: scanner.radios[0].firmware == "zigbee-ncp")
    await asyncio.sleep(0.05)
    assert at_once == [1]


async def test_a_probe_that_never_answers_gives_up(tmp_path, sticks, monkeypatch):
    class Silent(Driver):
        async def identify(self, path: str) -> str | None:
            await asyncio.Event().wait()  # e.g. bellows resetting a port someone else holds
            return None

    monkeypatch.setattr(usb, "PROBE_TIMEOUT", 0.01)
    plug(sticks, "odd")
    scanner = UsbScanner([Silent()])
    async with asyncio.timeout(1):
        await run(tmp_path, scanner)
    assert scanner.radios[0].driver is None


async def test_a_radio_is_released_before_it_is_flashed_and_used_again_after(tmp_path, sticks):
    seen_while_flashed = []

    class Flashing(Driver):
        def flashable(self, path: str, channel: str) -> list[str]:
            return ["zigbee-ncp", "multipan-rcp"]

        async def flash(self, path: str, firmware: str, channel: str, cache: Path):
            seen_while_flashed.append(state(runtime, integration))
            self.recognised["sky"] = firmware

    plug(sticks, "sky")
    integration = FakePeripheral("zigbee", [Need("zigbee")], answer=True)
    multipan = FakePeripheral("multipan", [Need("multipan")])
    scanner = UsbScanner([Flashing(sky="zigbee-ncp")])
    runtime = await run(tmp_path, scanner, integration, multipan)

    await scanner.radios[0].flash("multipan-rcp")
    await settle(runtime)
    assert seen_while_flashed == [PeripheralState.WAITING]  # it let go of the stick first
    assert (state(runtime, integration), state(runtime, multipan)) == (PeripheralState.WAITING, PeripheralState.RUNNING)


async def test_a_radio_being_flashed_refuses_another_flash_probe_or_forget(tmp_path, sticks):
    gate = asyncio.Event()

    class Flashing(Driver):
        def flashable(self, path: str, channel: str) -> list[str]:
            return ["zigbee-ncp", "multipan-rcp"]

        async def flash(self, path: str, firmware: str, channel: str, cache: Path):
            await gate.wait()
            self.recognised["sky"] = firmware

    plug(sticks, "sky")
    scanner = UsbScanner([Flashing(sky="zigbee-ncp")])
    runtime = await run(tmp_path, scanner, zigbee())
    [radio] = scanner.radios
    flashing = asyncio.create_task(radio.flash("multipan-rcp"))
    await until(runtime, lambda: radio.is_busy, settled=False)

    for again in (radio.flash("zigbee-ncp"), radio.probe(), radio.forget()):  # a double tap, a second app
        with pytest.raises(RadioBusy):
            await again
    gate.set()
    await flashing
    await settle(runtime)
    assert (radio.is_busy, radio.firmware) == (False, "multipan-rcp")


async def test_a_radio_whose_flash_failed_serves_what_it_runs_now(tmp_path, sticks):
    class Bricking(Driver):
        def flashable(self, path: str, channel: str) -> list[str]:
            return ["multipan-rcp"]

        async def flash(self, path: str, firmware: str, channel: str, cache: Path):
            del self.recognised["sky"]  # left in its bootloader
            raise RuntimeError("the flasher crashed")

    plug(sticks, "sky")
    integration, scanner = zigbee(), UsbScanner([Bricking(sky="zigbee-ncp")])
    runtime = await run(tmp_path, scanner, integration)
    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="crashed"):
        await scanner.radios[0].flash("multipan-rcp")
    await settle(runtime)
    assert (scanner.radios[0].firmware, scanner.radios[0].provides) == (None, [])
    assert state(runtime, integration) == PeripheralState.WAITING


async def test_the_firmware_offered_follows_the_radios_channel(tmp_path):
    radio = Radio(SKYCONNECT, f"/dev/serial/by-id/{SKYCONNECT}", lambda: [], Silabs(), "thread-rcp")
    runtime = await run(tmp_path, FakePeripheral("board", provides=[radio]), zigbee())
    assert radio.options == []  # stable channel: nothing verified to flash yet

    await runtime.update_settings(radio, {"firmware_channel": "dev"})
    assert radio.options == ["zigbee-ncp", "thread-rcp", "multipan-rcp"]
    assert runtime.reach(Silabs().serves("multipan-rcp", "x")) == []  # nothing here needs what it would serve
    assert runtime.reach(Silabs().serves("zigbee-ncp", "x")) == ["zigbee"]


async def test_switching_a_radios_firmware_channel_restarts_nothing(tmp_path):
    radio = Radio(SKYCONNECT, f"/dev/serial/by-id/{SKYCONNECT}", lambda: [], Silabs(), "zigbee-ncp")
    output, integration = RecordingRuntimeOutput(), zigbee()
    runtime = await run(tmp_path, FakePeripheral("board", provides=[radio]), integration, output=output)
    told = len(output.statuses)

    await runtime.update_settings(radio, {"firmware_channel": "dev"})  # it only changes what it may be flashed to
    await settle(runtime)
    assert output.statuses[told:] == [] and integration.calls == ["start"]


async def test_a_multiprotocol_firmware_that_serves_bluetooth_offers_it_too(tmp_path, sticks, monkeypatch):
    asked: list[str] = []

    async def has_bluetooth(path: str) -> bool:
        asked.append(path)
        return True

    monkeypatch.setattr(cpc_hci, "has_bluetooth", has_bluetooth)
    plug(sticks, "sky", "ncp")
    scanner = UsbScanner([Driver(sky="multipan-rcp", ncp="zigbee-ncp")])
    await run(tmp_path, scanner)

    sky, ncp = sorted(scanner.radios, key=lambda r: r.name, reverse=True)
    assert asked == ["/dev/serial/by-id/sky"]  # a multi-PAN firmware only, asked once
    assert sky.provides[-1] == Endpoint("ble", "silabs-cpc-hci", "/dev/serial/by-id/sky", params={"hci": None})
    assert [e.family for e in ncp.provides] == ["zigbee"]


async def test_the_cpc_probe_says_no_until_verified_on_hardware():
    assert await cpc_hci.has_bluetooth("/dev/ttyUSB0") is False
    with pytest.raises(ConnectionError, match="no Bluetooth adapter"):
        cpc_hci.source_of(Endpoint("ble", "silabs-cpc-hci", "/dev/ttyUSB0", params={"hci": None}))


async def test_soldered_radios_are_used_without_asking_wired_as_the_board_says(tmp_path):
    (tmp_path / "ttyAMA3").touch()
    driver = Driver(ttyAMA3="zigbee-ncp")
    board = FixedPeripherals(
        FixedRadio("mg26", str(tmp_path / "ttyAMA3"), "silabs", "zigbee-ncp", {"flow_control": False}),
        FixedRadio("absent", str(tmp_path / "ttyAMA4"), "silabs", "zigbee-ncp"),
        FixedRadio("unknown", str(tmp_path / "ttyAMA3"), "silabs"),
        drivers=[driver],
    )
    integration = zigbee()
    runtime = await run(tmp_path, board, integration)

    assert [radio.name for radio in board.provides] == ["mg26", "unknown"]  # one that isn't there is left out
    expected = Endpoint("zigbee", "ezsp", str(tmp_path / "ttyAMA3"), params={"baud": 115200, "flow_control": False})
    assert integration.peripherals.endpoint("zigbee") == expected
    assert driver.opened == ["ttyAMA3"]  # only the one whose firmware the board doesn't tell
    assert runtime.status(board.provides[1]).state == PeripheralState.RUNNING


async def test_the_host_offers_its_network_and_every_adapter_with_its_index(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    found = ["/sys/class/bluetooth/hci1", "/sys/class/bluetooth/hci0", "/sys/class/bluetooth/hci0:1"]
    monkeypatch.setattr(host, "glob", lambda pattern: list(found))
    monkeypatch.setattr(host.sys, "platform", "linux")
    monkeypatch.setattr(host, "POLL", 0.01)
    adapters = BluetoothAdapters()
    sniffer = FakePeripheral("sniffer", [Need("ip"), Need("ble", is_many=True)], answer=True)
    runtime = await run(tmp_path, HostNetwork(), adapters, sniffer)
    assert runtime.bound(sniffer) == {
        "ip": Endpoint("ip", is_shared=True),
        "ble": [
            Endpoint("ble", "bluez", "hci0", params={"index": "0"}),
            Endpoint("ble", "bluez", "hci1", params={"index": "1"}),
        ],
    }

    found.append("/sys/class/bluetooth/hci2")  # plugged in
    await until(runtime, lambda: len(sniffer.peripherals.endpoints("ble")) == 3)


def test_off_linux_the_host_has_its_default_adapter(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(host.sys, "platform", "darwin")
    assert host._adapters() == [""]


async def test_endpoints_pinned_first_win_and_come_and_go(tmp_path, sticks):
    plug(sticks, "sky")
    mine = Endpoint("zigbee", "ezsp", "socket://192.168.1.5:6638", is_shared=True)
    pinned, integration = Pinned(mine), FakePeripheral("zigbee", [Need("zigbee")], answer=True)
    runtime = await run(tmp_path, pinned, UsbScanner([Driver(sky="zigbee-ncp")]), integration)
    assert integration.peripherals.endpoint("zigbee") == mine

    await pinned.unpin("zigbee")
    await settle(runtime)
    assert integration.peripherals.endpoint("zigbee").url == "/dev/serial/by-id/sky"
    await pinned.pin(mine)
    await settle(runtime)
    assert runtime.providers(integration) == {"zigbee": "pinned"}


================================================================================
# FILE: tests/runtime/test_integration.py
================================================================================
"""An integration controller run by the runtime like any peripheral: its platform, settings and peripherals."""

import json
from typing import cast
from uuid import UUID, uuid4

from pydantic import BaseModel
from support import run, settle

from majordom_integration_sdk import AbstractController, Endpoint, IntegrationError, Need, Peripheral, Platform, Service
from majordom_integration_sdk.runtime import HostNetwork, MemoryDisabledStore, PeripheralState, PeripheralStatus
from majordom_integration_sdk.runtime import StatusKind as K
from majordom_integration_sdk.schemas.device import Device, Discovery, Parameter
from majordom_integration_sdk.testing import FakeCompose, FakePeripheral, RecordingControllerOutput, build_test_platform

DEVICE = uuid4()


class Greeting(BaseModel):
    greeting: str = "hello"


def echo_server() -> Service[Greeting]:
    return Service(
        "echo-server",
        compose={"image": "echo", "command": ["--greeting", "{settings.greeting}"]},
        needs=[Need("ip")],
        provides=[Endpoint("example", "echo", "ws://127.0.0.1:{ports.api}")],
        settings=Greeting,
        ports={"api": 5600},
    )


class EchoController(AbstractController[Device, Parameter, "EchoController.Settings"]):
    needs = [Need("example", ["echo"])]

    class Settings(BaseModel):
        is_loud: bool = False

    def __init__(self, platform: Platform, *, settings: Settings | None = None):
        super().__init__(platform, settings=settings)
        self.started_with: list[tuple[str, bool]] = []

    @property
    def discoveries(self) -> dict[UUID, Discovery]:
        return {}

    async def start(self):
        self.started_with.append((self.peripherals.endpoint("example").url, self.settings.is_loud))

    async def stop(self):
        pass

    async def settings_did_change(self, before) -> bool:
        return True  # it tells the server over its connection

    async def pair_device(self, discovery, credentials):
        pass

    async def unpair(self, device):
        pass

    async def identify(self, device):
        pass

    async def fetch(self, device):
        pass

    async def send_command(self, command, device, parameter):
        pass


def peripherals(platform: Platform) -> list[Peripheral]:
    """What the integration package exports: its server, and the controller that needs it."""
    return [echo_server(), EchoController(platform)]


def integration() -> tuple[Service[Greeting], EchoController]:
    """What the integration exports, given its platform as by the Hub."""
    server, echo = peripherals(build_test_platform())
    assert isinstance(server, Service) and isinstance(echo, EchoController)
    return cast(Service[Greeting], server), echo


async def test_an_integration_runs_once_the_server_it_provides_serves(tmp_path):
    server, echo = integration()
    runtime = await run(tmp_path, HostNetwork(), FakeCompose(), server, echo)

    assert runtime.status(echo) == PeripheralStatus(PeripheralState.RUNNING)
    assert echo.started_with == [("ws://127.0.0.1:5600", False)]  # its needs bound, its settings given, before start
    assert runtime.users(server) == ["echo"] and echo.key == "echo"  # known by its slug


async def test_an_integration_is_kept_by_its_slug_and_shown_by_its_name(tmp_path):
    class ZWaveJS(EchoController):
        name = "Z-Wave JS"

    store, server, echo = MemoryDisabledStore(), echo_server(), ZWaveJS(build_test_platform())
    runtime = await run(tmp_path, HostNetwork(), FakeCompose(), server, echo, disabled=store)
    await runtime.update_settings(echo, {"is_loud": True})
    await runtime.disable(echo)

    assert (echo.key, echo.name) == ("z-wave-js", "Z-Wave JS")
    documents = tmp_path / "data" / "peripherals" / "z-wave-js"
    assert store.is_disabled("z-wave-js") and echo.platform.documents_folder(echo) == documents
    assert json.loads((tmp_path / "data" / "state.json").read_text())["settings"]["z-wave-js"] == {"is_loud": True}
    assert runtime.peripheral("z-wave-js") is echo


async def test_an_integration_and_its_server_keep_their_settings(tmp_path):
    server, echo = integration()
    runtime = await run(tmp_path, HostNetwork(), FakeCompose(), server, echo)
    compose = tmp_path / "data" / "peripherals" / "compose" / "compose.json"

    await runtime.update_settings(server, {"greeting": "hi"})
    await settle(runtime)
    assert json.loads(compose.read_text())["services"]["echo-server"]["command"] == ["--greeting", "hi"]
    assert echo.started_with == [("ws://127.0.0.1:5600", False)]  # the server restarted under it: it reconnects

    await runtime.update_settings(echo, {"is_loud": True})
    await settle(runtime)
    assert echo.settings.is_loud and len(echo.started_with) == 1  # applied in place

    server, again = integration()  # after a reboot
    await run(tmp_path, HostNetwork(), FakeCompose(), server, again)
    assert again.started_with == [("ws://127.0.0.1:5600", True)]


async def test_an_integration_waits_with_a_reason_when_its_server_cant_run(tmp_path):
    server, echo = integration()
    runtime = await run(tmp_path, FakeCompose(), server, echo)  # no network for the server
    assert runtime.status(echo) == PeripheralStatus(
        PeripheralState.WAITING,
        K.NEEDS_UNBOUND,
        "need example/echo: echo-server can't run (need ip/*: nothing offers it)",
    )
    assert echo.started_with == []


async def test_a_controller_given_its_settings_keeps_them_until_the_user_changes_them(tmp_path):
    echo = EchoController(build_test_platform(), settings=EchoController.Settings(is_loud=True))  # library mode
    await run(tmp_path, HostNetwork(), FakeCompose(), echo_server(), echo)
    assert echo.started_with == [("ws://127.0.0.1:5600", True)]

    server, again = integration()  # after a reboot
    await run(tmp_path, HostNetwork(), FakeCompose(), server, again)
    assert again.started_with == [("ws://127.0.0.1:5600", True)]


# what a controller tells, through the one output every peripheral shares


async def test_every_peripheral_shares_one_output_and_a_controllers_reports_reach_the_hub(tmp_path):
    hub, server, echo = RecordingControllerOutput(), *integration()
    runtime = await run(tmp_path, HostNetwork(), FakeCompose(), server, echo, controller_output=hub)
    assert echo.output is server.output and not hasattr(echo, "runtime")

    await echo.output.controller_did_lose_device(echo, DEVICE)
    await echo.output.controller_did_encounter_error(echo, IntegrationError("server-slow", "The server is slow."))
    assert hub.lost_devices == [DEVICE] and list(hub.errors) == ["server-slow"]
    assert runtime.status(echo).state == PeripheralState.RUNNING  # it goes on


async def test_a_controller_that_cant_go_on_says_why_and_is_tried_again(tmp_path):
    hub, server, echo = RecordingControllerOutput(), *integration()
    runtime = await run(tmp_path, HostNetwork(), FakeCompose(), server, echo, controller_output=hub)

    lost = IntegrationError("radio-lost", "The radio is gone: plug it in again.", is_still_running=False)
    await echo.output.controller_did_encounter_error(echo, lost)
    await settle(runtime)
    assert hub.errors == {"radio-lost": lost}  # the user sees it
    status = runtime.status(echo)
    assert (status.state, status.kind, status.detail.split(";")[0]) == (
        PeripheralState.WAITING,
        K.RETRYING,
        lost.message,
    )


async def test_what_a_controller_provides_is_read_again_when_it_says_so(tmp_path):
    class ESPHome(EchoController):
        name = "esphome"

        def __init__(self, platform: Platform):
            super().__init__(platform)
            self.proxies: list[Peripheral] = []

        @property
        def provides(self) -> list[Peripheral]:
            return self.proxies

    server, esphome = echo_server(), ESPHome(build_test_platform())
    runtime = await run(tmp_path, HostNetwork(), FakeCompose(), server, esphome)

    esphome.proxies.append(proxy := FakePeripheral("aa:bb"))  # a node connected
    await esphome.output.controller_did_change_provided(esphome)
    await settle(runtime)
    assert runtime.peripheral("esphome/aa:bb") is proxy and proxy.output is esphome.output


async def test_without_a_runtime_a_controller_logs_what_it_tells_or_reports_to_the_output_given(caplog):
    echo = EchoController(build_test_platform())  # library mode
    await echo.output.controller_did_encounter_error(echo, IntegrationError("down", "Down.", is_still_running=False))
    assert "Down." in caplog.text

    echo.output = hub = RecordingControllerOutput()
    await echo.output.controller_did_change_provided(echo)
    assert hub.provided_changes == [echo]

# FILE: tests/runtime/test_lifecycle.py
