"""A minimal concrete controller exercises the framework end to end with test doubles."""

import inspect
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from uuid import UUID

import pytest
from factories import make_device_state

from majordom_integration_sdk import NoSettings
from majordom_integration_sdk.controller import AbstractController, ControllerOutput, LoggingControllerOutput
from majordom_integration_sdk.repository import DeviceRepositoryMemory
from majordom_integration_sdk.schemas.command import DeviceCommand
from majordom_integration_sdk.schemas.device import Device, Discovery, Parameter, ProvidedCredentials
from majordom_integration_sdk.schemas.event import DeviceParameterChange
from majordom_integration_sdk.testing import RecordingControllerOutput, build_test_platform


class _MinimalController(AbstractController[Device, Parameter]):
    name = "Example Protocol"

    @property
    def discoveries(self) -> dict[UUID, Discovery]:
        return {}

    async def start(self):
        pass

    async def stop(self):
        pass

    async def pair_device(self, discovery: Discovery, credentials: ProvidedCredentials | None):
        pass

    async def unpair(self, device: Device):
        pass

    async def identify(self, device: Device):
        pass

    async def fetch(self, device: Device):
        pass

    async def send_command(self, command: DeviceCommand, device: Device, parameter: Parameter):
        pass


def test_key_and_uuid_helpers():
    controller = _MinimalController(build_test_platform())
    assert controller.key == "example-protocol"
    # Deterministic, namespaced, and hierarchical.
    device_uuid = controller.device_uuid("abc")
    assert controller.device_uuid("abc") == device_uuid
    assert controller.parameter_uuid(device_uuid, "p1") != device_uuid


def test_its_documents_folder_is_its_own_under_the_platforms(tmp_path):
    controller = _MinimalController(build_test_platform(documents_root=tmp_path))
    assert controller.platform.documents_folder(controller) == tmp_path / "example-protocol"
    assert (tmp_path / "example-protocol").is_dir()


LEAVES = """
from majordom_integration_sdk.testing import build_test_platform

for platform in (build_test_platform(), build_test_platform()):
    (platform.documents_root / "zigbee").mkdir()
    (platform.documents_root / "zigbee" / "app.db").write_text("devices")
    print(platform.documents_root)
"""


def test_a_platform_built_without_a_root_leaves_no_folder_behind():
    # a folder each, never removed, piled up in the temp folder run after run
    roots = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-c", LEAVES], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.split()
    assert len(set(roots)) == 2 and not any(Path(root).exists() for root in roots)


async def test_its_device_repository_holds_only_its_own_devices():
    controller = _MinimalController(build_test_platform())
    device = make_device_state(integration=controller.key)  # its slug, "example-protocol"
    async with controller.platform.device_repository(controller) as repo:
        await repo.save(device)
        stored = await repo.state(device.id)
        assert stored is not None and stored.id == device.id
        with pytest.raises(PermissionError):
            await repo.save(make_device_state(integration="Other"))


async def test_recording_output_captures_reports():
    controller = _MinimalController(build_test_platform())
    output = controller.output = RecordingControllerOutput()

    device = make_device_state()
    change = DeviceParameterChange(device_id=device.id, parameter_id=device.parameters[0].id, value=1)
    await output.controller_did_connect_device(controller, device.id)
    await output.controller_did_receive_events(controller, [change])

    assert output.connected_devices == [device.id]
    assert output.events == [change]


def test_name_is_autoderived_from_class_name():
    """`name` defaults to the class name (CamelCase → spaced), overridable with an explicit `name`."""

    class HueController(AbstractController[Device, Parameter]):
        pass

    class ZigBeeController(AbstractController[Device, Parameter]):
        name = "ZigBee"  # override the "Zig Bee" default

    assert HueController.name == "Hue"
    assert HueController.slug() == "hue"
    assert ZigBeeController.name == "ZigBee"
    assert ZigBeeController.slug() == "zigbee"


async def test_the_pairing_window_opens_without_credentials():
    # the Hub broadcasts `start_pairing_window(duration)`: credentials are only for the one integration that needs them
    controller = _MinimalController(build_test_platform())
    await controller.start_pairing_window(5)


async def test_changed_settings_restart_it_unless_handled_and_the_platform_facts_dont():
    controller = _MinimalController(build_test_platform())
    assert await controller.settings_did_change(NoSettings()) is False
    assert await controller.platform_facts_did_change(build_test_platform(region="Europe")) is True


async def test_a_test_platform_holds_the_facts_given_and_its_store_every_device():
    store: dict = {}
    platform = build_test_platform(region="Europe", thread_dataset="0e08", store=store)
    controller = _MinimalController(platform)
    async with platform.device_repository(controller) as repo:
        await repo.save(make_device_state(integration=controller.key))

    assert (platform.region, platform.wifi, platform.thread_dataset) == ("Europe", None, "0e08")
    async with DeviceRepositoryMemory(store=store).session() as everything:
        assert [device.integration for device in await everything.get_all()] == ["example-protocol"]


def test_the_output_annotations_evaluate():
    """A host reads them, e.g. the Hub's null output: each names the controller it hears from."""
    for output in (ControllerOutput, LoggingControllerOutput):
        for name, method in inspect.getmembers(output, inspect.isfunction):
            if name.startswith("controller_did_"):
                assert inspect.get_annotations(method, eval_str=True)["controller"] is AbstractController, name


================================================================================
# FILE: tests/test_credentials.py
================================================================================
"""Pairing credentials: what a discovery expects (CredentialsOption) vs. what a pairing supplies."""

import warnings
from uuid import uuid4

import pytest
from pydantic import BaseModel

from majordom_integration_sdk.schemas.credentials import WifiCredentials
from majordom_integration_sdk.schemas.device import (
    CredentialsOption,
    CredentialsType,
    Discovery,
    ProvidedCredentials,
)


def _discovery(options: list) -> Discovery:
    return Discovery(
        id=uuid4(),
        integration="test",
        expected_credentials_options=options,
        transport="test",
        device_manufacturer=None,
        device_name="Bulb",
        device_category=None,
        device_icon=None,
    )


def test_the_mask_is_serialized():
    discovery = _discovery([CredentialsOption(type=CredentialsType.code, mask="DDDD-DDD-DDDD")])
    dumped = discovery.model_dump(mode="json")["expected_credentials_options"]
    assert dumped == [{"type": "code", "mask": "DDDD-DDD-DDDD", "hint": None}]
    assert Discovery.model_validate_json(discovery.model_dump_json()) == discovery


@pytest.mark.parametrize("legacy", [[CredentialsType.code, CredentialsType.qr], ["code", "qr"]])
def test_bare_types_are_accepted_for_stored_discoveries_and_older_integrations(legacy: list):
    discovery = _discovery(legacy)
    assert discovery.expected_credentials_options == [
        CredentialsOption(type=CredentialsType.code),
        CredentialsOption(type=CredentialsType.qr),
    ]


def test_a_stored_legacy_discovery_loads_from_json():
    stored = _discovery([CredentialsOption(type=CredentialsType.secret)]).model_dump(mode="json")
    stored["expected_credentials_options"] = ["secret"]
    loaded = Discovery.model_validate(stored)
    assert loaded.expected_credentials_options == [CredentialsOption(type=CredentialsType.secret)]


def test_with_mask_no_longer_mutates_the_shared_enum_member():
    with warnings.catch_warnings():
        warnings.simplefilter("error")
        option = CredentialsType.code.with_mask("DDD-DD-DDD")
    assert option == CredentialsOption(type=CredentialsType.code, mask="DDD-DD-DDD")
    assert not hasattr(CredentialsType.code, "code_mask")
    # the mask now survives the trip to the Hub
    assert _discovery([option]).model_dump(mode="json")["expected_credentials_options"][0]["mask"] == "DDD-DD-DDD"


def test_with_hint_returns_an_option_with_the_hint():
    with warnings.catch_warnings():
        warnings.simplefilter("error")
        option = CredentialsType.button.with_hint("Press the button")
    assert option == CredentialsOption(type=CredentialsType.button, hint="Press the button")
    assert not hasattr(CredentialsType.button, "hint")


def test_with_mask_can_carry_a_hint():
    option = CredentialsType.code.with_mask("DDD-DD-DDD", hint="On the box")
    assert option == CredentialsOption(type=CredentialsType.code, mask="DDD-DD-DDD", hint="On the box")
    dumped = _discovery([option]).model_dump(mode="json")["expected_credentials_options"]
    assert dumped == [{"type": "code", "mask": "DDD-DD-DDD", "hint": "On the box"}]


def test_each_call_returns_a_new_option_and_leaves_the_type_untouched():
    assert CredentialsType.code.with_hint("x") is not CredentialsType.code.with_hint("x")
    assert CredentialsType.code.with_mask("DDDD") is not CredentialsType.code.with_mask("DDDD")
    assert CredentialsType.code == "code"


def test_option_is_a_plain_data_model_without_builders():
    option = CredentialsOption(type=CredentialsType.code)
    assert not hasattr(option, "with_mask")
    assert not hasattr(option, "with_hint")


def test_existing_membership_checks_against_bare_types_keep_working():
    # integrations do `credentials.type not in discovery.expected_credentials_options`
    discovery = _discovery([CredentialsOption(type=CredentialsType.code, mask="DDD-DD-DDD")])
    assert CredentialsType.code in discovery.expected_credentials_options
    assert CredentialsType.qr not in discovery.expected_credentials_options


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("credentials", "accepted"),
    [
        (ProvidedCredentials(type=CredentialsType.code, value="123-45-678"), True),
        (ProvidedCredentials(type=CredentialsType.button), True),
        (ProvidedCredentials(type=CredentialsType.secret, value="key"), False),
        (None, False),
    ],
)
def test_accepts_matches_the_provided_type_against_the_options(credentials: ProvidedCredentials | None, accepted: bool):
    discovery = _discovery([CredentialsType.button, CredentialsOption(type=CredentialsType.code, mask="DDD-DD-DDD")])
    assert discovery.accepts(credentials) is accepted


def test_no_credentials_are_accepted_only_where_none_is_an_option():
    assert _discovery([CredentialsType.none]).accepts(None)
    assert _discovery([CredentialsType.none]).accepts(ProvidedCredentials(type=CredentialsType.none))


def test_button_is_a_confirmation_without_a_value():
    credentials = ProvidedCredentials(type=CredentialsType.button)
    assert credentials.value is None
    assert ProvidedCredentials.model_validate({"type": "button"}) == credentials
    assert CredentialsType.button != CredentialsType.none


def test_a_discovery_can_offer_button_or_qr():
    discovery = _discovery([CredentialsType.button, CredentialsType.qr])
    assert [o.type for o in discovery.expected_credentials_options] == [CredentialsType.button, CredentialsType.qr]


def test_a_wifi_password_is_written_never_read_back():
    # settings holding a network (the Hub's saved ones) never return its password: their schema says so
    class Saved(BaseModel):
        wifi: list[WifiCredentials] = []

    schema = Saved.model_json_schema()
    assert schema["$defs"]["WifiCredentials"]["properties"]["password"]["writeOnly"] is True
    assert "writeOnly" not in schema["$defs"]["WifiCredentials"]["properties"]["ssid"]
    assert WifiCredentials("home") == WifiCredentials("home", "")


================================================================================
# FILE: tests/test_dev.py
================================================================================
"""Smoke tests for the standalone dev runner (``majordom_integration_sdk.dev``).

``run_controller`` binds needs through the runtime and then blocks forever, so it is never run whole
against real radios in CI. These tests cover the parts that can break without a device on the
network: ``build_platform`` assembles a correctly-scoped platform, the `Runner` runs a controller
under the runtime as the Hub does (among fake peripherals), and ``run_controller`` starts and stops
cleanly.
"""

import asyncio
from dataclasses import replace
from uuid import UUID

import pytest
from factories import make_device_state

import majordom_integration_sdk.dev as dev
from majordom_integration_sdk import Endpoint, Need, PeripheralChange
from majordom_integration_sdk.capabilities import BLE_ROUTER
from majordom_integration_sdk.controller import AbstractController
from majordom_integration_sdk.dev import LoggingControllerOutput, Runner, build_platform, build_runtime, run_controller
from majordom_integration_sdk.runtime import Pinned, Runtime
from majordom_integration_sdk.runtime.output import HostOutput
from majordom_integration_sdk.schemas.command import DeviceCommand
from majordom_integration_sdk.schemas.device import Device, Discovery, Parameter, ProvidedCredentials
from majordom_integration_sdk.testing import FakeBLERouter, FakePeripheral, FakeSSDP

ZWAVE = Endpoint("zwave", "zwave-js-server", "ws://127.0.0.1:3000", is_shared=True)


class _RecordingController(AbstractController[Device, Parameter]):
    """Minimal controller that records that it was started and stopped, and the peripheral changes it saw."""

    name = "Dev Example"
    needs = [Need("zwave", ["zwave-js-server"]), Need("ble", ["router"], is_required=False)]
    instances: list["_RecordingController"] = []
    handles_changes = True

    def __init__(self, platform):
        super().__init__(platform)
        self.started = self.stopped = 0
        self.changes: list[PeripheralChange] = []
        _RecordingController.instances.append(self)

    @property
    def discoveries(self) -> dict[UUID, Discovery]:
        return {}

    async def start(self):
        self.started += 1

    async def stop(self):
        self.stopped += 1

    async def needed_peripheral_did_change(self, change: PeripheralChange) -> bool:
        self.changes.append(change)
        return self.handles_changes

    async def pair_device(self, discovery: Discovery, credentials: ProvidedCredentials | None):
        pass

    async def unpair(self, device: Device):
        pass

    async def identify(self, device: Device):
        pass

    async def fetch(self, device: Device):
        pass

    async def send_command(self, command: DeviceCommand, device: Device, parameter: Parameter):
        pass


def peripherals(platform) -> list[_RecordingController]:
    """What its integration package exports."""
    return [_RecordingController(platform)]


@pytest.fixture
def router() -> FakeBLERouter:
    return FakeBLERouter()


def runner(tmp_path, router: FakeBLERouter, pinned=()) -> tuple[Runner, _RecordingController, Runtime]:
    """A controller under the runtime, among peripherals without radios or sockets."""
    controller = _RecordingController(build_platform(storage_root=tmp_path))
    runtime = build_runtime(
        [controller],
        tmp_path / "runtime",
        runtime_peripherals=[router, FakeSSDP()],
        pinned=pinned,
        platform=controller.platform,
    )
    return Runner(controller, runtime), controller, runtime


async def until(condition):
    async with asyncio.timeout(2):
        while not condition():
            await asyncio.sleep(0.01)


# --- build_platform -----------------------------------------------------------------------


def test_build_platform_roots_every_peripherals_documents_folder(tmp_path):
    platform = build_platform(storage_root=tmp_path)
    assert platform.documents_root == tmp_path and tmp_path.is_dir()


async def test_build_platform_memory_repository_round_trips_in_its_scope(tmp_path):
    platform = build_platform(storage_root=tmp_path)
    device = make_device_state(integration="example")
    async with platform.make_device_repository("example") as repo:
        await repo.save(device)
    async with platform.make_device_repository("example") as repo:
        assert (await repo.state(device.id)) is not None
    async with platform.make_device_repository("other") as repo:
        assert (await repo.state(device.id)) is None


async def test_build_platform_sqlite_persists_to_file(tmp_path):
    db_path = tmp_path / "dev.sqlite"
    device = make_device_state(integration="example")

    platform = build_platform(storage_root=tmp_path, db_path=db_path)
    async with platform.make_device_repository("example") as repo:
        await repo.save(device)

    assert db_path.exists(), "a db_path should select the file-backed sqlite repository"
    # A fresh platform over the same file sees the persisted device (survives 'restarts').
    again = build_platform(storage_root=tmp_path, db_path=db_path)
    async with again.make_device_repository("example") as repo:
        assert (await repo.state(device.id)) is not None


# --- the runtime --------------------------------------------------------------------------


def test_without_the_runtime_extra_the_runner_says_what_to_install(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(dev.importlib.util, "find_spec", lambda name: None)
    platform = build_platform(storage_root=tmp_path)
    with pytest.raises(ImportError, match=r"majordom-integration-sdk\[runtime"):
        build_runtime([_RecordingController(platform)], tmp_path, platform=platform)


async def test_the_runner_starts_the_controller_once_its_needs_are_bound(tmp_path, router):
    runner_, controller, runtime = runner(tmp_path, router)
    await runner_.start()
    assert not controller.started  # nothing offers zwave-js-server here
    assert "zwave" in runtime.unbound(controller)
    pinned = runtime.peripherals[0]
    assert isinstance(pinned, Pinned)

    await pinned.pin(ZWAVE)
    await until(lambda: runner_.is_running)
    assert controller.peripherals.endpoint("zwave") == ZWAVE
    assert controller.peripherals.instance(BLE_ROUTER) is router  # the router, as under the Hub

    await pinned.unpin("zwave")  # a required need lost: stopped until it's back
    assert controller.stopped == 1 and not runner_.is_running
    await runner_.stop()


async def test_the_runner_hands_a_moved_peripheral_over_or_restarts(tmp_path, router):
    runner_, controller, runtime = runner(tmp_path, router, pinned=[ZWAVE])
    await runner_.start()
    await until(lambda: runner_.is_running)
    pinned = runtime.peripherals[0]
    assert isinstance(pinned, Pinned)
    moved = Endpoint("zwave", "zwave-js-server", "ws://192.168.1.9:3000", is_shared=True)

    await pinned.pin(moved)
    appeared = PeripheralChange("ble", None, router.endpoint)  # the router started beside it, at boot
    assert controller.changes == [appeared, PeripheralChange("zwave", ZWAVE, moved)]
    assert (controller.started, controller.stopped) == (1, 0)  # handled in place

    controller.handles_changes = False
    await pinned.pin(ZWAVE)
    await until(lambda: controller.started == 2)
    assert controller.stopped == 1
    await runner_.stop()


async def test_run_controller_with_peripherals_given_runs_without_the_runtime(tmp_path):
    _RecordingController.instances.clear()
    task = asyncio.create_task(run_controller(peripherals, storage_root=tmp_path, peripherals={"zwave": ZWAVE}))

    async with asyncio.timeout(5):
        while not (_RecordingController.instances and _RecordingController.instances[-1].started):
            await asyncio.sleep(0.01)

    task.cancel()
    await task  # run_controller swallows the cancellation after cleaning up

    controller = _RecordingController.instances[-1]
    assert controller.started and controller.stopped
    assert controller.peripherals.endpoint("zwave") == ZWAVE
    assert controller.platform.documents_folder(controller) == tmp_path / "dev-example"  # by its key, as by the Hub
    assert isinstance(controller.output, LoggingControllerOutput)  # what it reports is logged
    assert not (tmp_path / "runtime").exists()


async def test_run_controller_wants_one_controller_among_what_an_integration_exports(tmp_path):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="one controller, not 2"):
        await run_controller(lambda platform: peripherals(platform) * 2, storage_root=tmp_path)


async def test_run_controller_starts_and_stops_cleanly_under_the_runtime(tmp_path):
    _RecordingController.instances.clear()
    task = asyncio.create_task(
        run_controller(
            peripherals,
            storage_root=tmp_path,
            runtime_peripherals=[FakeSSDP()],
            pinned=[ZWAVE],
            region="Europe",
        )
    )

    async with asyncio.timeout(5):
        while not (_RecordingController.instances and _RecordingController.instances[-1].started):
            await asyncio.sleep(0.01)

    task.cancel()
    await task

    controller = _RecordingController.instances[-1]
    assert controller.started and controller.stopped
    assert controller.peripherals.endpoint("zwave") == ZWAVE  # bound by the runtime
    assert controller.platform.region == "Europe"  # the platform it was given, its overrides too
    output = controller.output  # the runtime's, which logs what it reports
    assert isinstance(output, HostOutput) and isinstance(output.controller_output, LoggingControllerOutput)


async def test_what_a_peripheral_learns_reaches_the_controllers_platform(tmp_path, router):
    border_router = FakePeripheral("my-border-router")
    controller = _RecordingController(replace(build_platform(storage_root=tmp_path), region="Europe"))
    runtime = build_runtime(
        [controller], tmp_path / "runtime", runtime_peripherals=[border_router], platform=controller.platform
    )
    await runtime.start()

    await border_router.output.peripheral_did_learn(border_router, {"thread_dataset": "0e08"})
    assert (controller.platform.region, controller.platform.thread_dataset) == ("Europe", "0e08")
    await runtime.stop()

# FILE: tests/test_errors.py

"""MissingCredentialsError: what the Hub lacks to pair a device."""

import pytest

from majordom_integration_sdk import MissingCredentialsError


def test_the_type_defaults_to_wifi():
    assert MissingCredentialsError().type == MissingCredentialsError.WIFI == "wifi"


def test_the_known_types():
    assert MissingCredentialsError.THREAD == "thread"


def test_the_message_carries_the_type():
    assert str(MissingCredentialsError("thread")) == "Missing credentials: thread"


def test_a_custom_type_is_accepted():
    assert MissingCredentialsError("zigbee_network_key").type == "zigbee_network_key"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("type_", ["", "WiFi", "wi-fi", "thread network", "_wifi", "wifi_", "1wifi"])
def test_the_type_is_lower_snake_case(type_: str):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        MissingCredentialsError(type_)


def test_the_hub_already_handles_it_as_a_lookup_error():
    assert issubclass(MissingCredentialsError, LookupError)

# FILE: tests/test_files.py
================================================================================
"""What the SDK and integrations keep on disk themselves: JSON, written whole or not at all, for its owner alone."""

import importlib

import pytest

from majordom_integration_sdk.files import read_json, write_json


def test_json_is_written_whole_for_its_owner_alone(tmp_path):
    path = tmp_path / "esphome" / "keys.json"  # an integration's own: the keys it set on its nodes
    write_json(path, {"node": "secret"})
    assert read_json(path) == {"node": "secret"}
    assert path.stat().st_mode & 0o777 == 0o600 and not path.with_name("keys.json.tmp").exists()


def test_missing_or_unreadable_json_reads_as_nothing(tmp_path):
    (tmp_path / "broken.json").write_text("{")
    assert read_json(tmp_path / "missing.json") == read_json(tmp_path / "broken.json") == {}


def test_one_import_path_outside_the_runtime():
    with pytest.raises(ImportError):
        importlib.import_module("majordom_integration_sdk.runtime.files")


================================================================================
# FILE: tests/test_main_parameter.py
================================================================================
from uuid import uuid4

from majordom_integration_sdk.schemas.parameter import (
    Parameter,
    ParameterDataType,
    ParameterRole,
    ParameterVisibility,
    next_main_parameter_value,
)


def _p(*, data_type, valid_values=None, default_value=None, cls=Parameter):
    return cls(
        id=uuid4(),
        name="p",
        data_type=data_type,
        role=ParameterRole.control,
        visibility=ParameterVisibility.user,
        valid_values=valid_values,
        default_value=default_value,
        integration_data=None,
    )


def test_cycle_toggles_between_two_values():
    assert next_main_parameter_value(0, [0, 4]) == 4
    assert next_main_parameter_value(4, [0, 4]) == 0


def test_cycle_rotates_and_wraps():
    assert next_main_parameter_value(1, [0, 1, 2]) == 2
    assert next_main_parameter_value(2, [0, 1, 2]) == 0


def test_single_value_cycle_is_a_button():
    assert next_main_parameter_value(99, [3]) == 3  # always sets to 3 regardless of current


def test_unknown_current_starts_at_first():
    assert next_main_parameter_value(None, [0, 4]) == 0
    assert next_main_parameter_value(7, [0, 4]) == 0


def test_empty_cycle_returns_none():
    assert next_main_parameter_value(0, []) is None
    assert next_main_parameter_value(0, None) is None


def test_enum_with_valid_values_can_be_main():
    assert _p(data_type=ParameterDataType.enum, valid_values={0: "off", 4: "on"}).can_be_main_parameter


def test_enum_without_valid_values_cannot_be_main():
    assert not _p(data_type=ParameterDataType.enum).can_be_main_parameter


def test_default_value_makes_any_type_main():
    assert _p(data_type=ParameterDataType.integer, default_value=5).can_be_main_parameter


def test_valid_values_makes_any_type_main():
    assert _p(data_type=ParameterDataType.integer, valid_values={0: "off", 80: "bright"}).can_be_main_parameter


def test_main_cycle_from_valid_values():
    p = _p(data_type=ParameterDataType.integer, valid_values={80: "bright", 0: "off"})
    assert p.main_cycle == [0, 80]  # numeric order


def test_main_cycle_from_set_default_value():
    p = _p(data_type=ParameterDataType.integer, valid_values={0: "off", 40: "dim", 80: "bright"}, default_value={0, 80})
    assert p.main_cycle == [0, 80]  # the curated default_value subset wins over full valid_values
    assert p.default_value == {0, 80}  # a pythonic set (serializes to a JSON array)


def test_main_cycle_single_default_is_button():
    p = _p(data_type=ParameterDataType.integer, default_value=5)
    assert p.main_cycle == [5]


def test_main_cycle_bool_toggles():
    assert _p(data_type=ParameterDataType.bool).main_cycle == [False, True]


def test_main_cycle_none_command_is_not_a_cycle():
    assert _p(data_type=ParameterDataType.none).main_cycle is None


def test_value_is_pythonic():
    from majordom_integration_sdk.schemas.parameter import ParameterState

    p = _p(data_type=ParameterDataType.integer)
    state = ParameterState.model_validate(p, from_attributes=True)
    state.value = 42
    assert state.value == 42
    assert ParameterState.model_validate_json(state.model_dump_json()).value == 42


def test_non_user_visibility_cannot_be_main():
    p = _p(data_type=ParameterDataType.bool)
    p.visibility = ParameterVisibility.setting
    assert not p.can_be_main_parameter
    p.visibility = ParameterVisibility.system
    assert not p.can_be_main_parameter


class _UnparametrizedParameter(Parameter):  # integrations subclass without a type argument
    pass


def _roundtrip_from_json_data(p: Parameter) -> Parameter:
    # The repositories' read path: a JSON-mode dict validated back (not model_validate_json)
    return type(p).model_validate(p.model_dump(mode="json"))


def test_set_default_value_survives_roundtrip():
    p = _p(data_type=ParameterDataType.integer, default_value={0, 100}, cls=_UnparametrizedParameter)
    assert _roundtrip_from_json_data(p).default_value == {0, 100}


def test_main_cycle_survives_roundtrip():
    p = _p(data_type=ParameterDataType.integer, default_value={0, 100}, cls=_UnparametrizedParameter)
    assert _roundtrip_from_json_data(p).main_cycle == [0, 100]

# FILE: tests/test_notification.py
================================================================================
import asyncio
from typing import Any, cast

from majordom_integration_sdk import IntegrationError
from majordom_integration_sdk.schemas.notification import Notification, NotificationPriority, NotificationType
from majordom_integration_sdk.testing import RecordingControllerOutput


def test_notification_defaults():
    n = Notification(message="Firmware update available")
    assert n.type is NotificationType.info
    assert n.priority is NotificationPriority.normal
    assert n.ttl is None


def test_output_records_notification():
    out = RecordingControllerOutput()
    n = Notification(
        message="Re-plug the radio",
        type=NotificationType.warning,
        priority=NotificationPriority.urgent,
        ttl=30,
    )
    asyncio.run(out.controller_did_emit_notification(cast(Any, None), n))
    assert out.notifications == [n]


def test_output_keeps_the_active_errors_by_id():
    out = RecordingControllerOutput()
    lost, again = (
        IntegrationError("server-unreachable", "Server lost"),
        IntegrationError("server-unreachable", "Still lost"),
    )
    unplugged = IntegrationError("stick-unplugged", "Re-plug the stick")

    async def report():
        for error in (lost, unplugged, again):
            await out.controller_did_encounter_error(cast(Any, None), error)
        await out.controller_did_resolve_error(cast(Any, None), "stick-unplugged")
        await out.controller_did_resolve_error(cast(Any, None), "never-reported")

    asyncio.run(report())
    assert out.errors == {"server-unreachable": again}
    assert out.error_log == [lost, unplugged, again, "stick-unplugged", "never-reported"]

# FILE: tests/test_parameter_audit.py
================================================================================
from uuid import uuid4

from majordom_integration_sdk.parameter_audit import audit_device_parameters
from majordom_integration_sdk.schemas.parameter import (
    Parameter,
    ParameterDataType,
    ParameterRole,
    ParameterUnit,
    ParameterVisibility,
)


def _p(name, *, vis=ParameterVisibility.user, unit=ParameterUnit.plain, role=ParameterRole.sensor):
    return Parameter(
        id=uuid4(),
        name=name,
        data_type=ParameterDataType.integer,
        unit=unit,
        role=role,
        visibility=vis,
        integration_data=None,
    )


def test_clean_device_has_no_warnings():
    params = [
        _p("temperature", unit=ParameterUnit.celsius),
        _p("humidity", unit=ParameterUnit.percentage),
        _p("battery", unit=ParameterUnit.percentage, role=ParameterRole.sensor),
    ]
    assert audit_device_parameters("Sensor", params) == []


def test_flags_over_exposure():
    params = [_p(f"attr_{i}") for i in range(12)]
    warnings = audit_device_parameters("Flooded", params)
    assert any("over-exposed" in w for w in warnings)


def test_ignores_non_user_params_in_count():
    params = [_p(f"attr_{i}", vis=ParameterVisibility.system) for i in range(20)] + [_p("on_off")]
    assert audit_device_parameters("Lean", params) == []


def test_flags_near_duplicate_names():
    params = [_p("current_x", unit=ParameterUnit.percentage), _p("current_y", unit=ParameterUnit.percentage)]
    assert any("near-duplicate" in w for w in audit_device_parameters("Light", params))


def test_similar_name_whitelist_suppresses():
    params = [
        _p("occupied_heating_setpoint", unit=ParameterUnit.celsius, role=ParameterRole.control),
        _p("occupied_cooling_setpoint", unit=ParameterUnit.celsius, role=ParameterRole.control),
    ]
    warnings = audit_device_parameters(
        "Thermostat",
        params,
        ignore_similar_pairs=[("occupied_heating_setpoint", "occupied_cooling_setpoint")],
    )
    assert not any("near-duplicate" in w for w in warnings)


def test_flags_redundant_representation_group():
    params = [
        _p("current_hue", unit=ParameterUnit.percentage),
        _p("current_saturation", unit=ParameterUnit.percentage),
        _p("current_x", unit=ParameterUnit.percentage),
        _p("current_y", unit=ParameterUnit.percentage),
    ]
    assert any("redundant representations" in w for w in audit_device_parameters("Light", params))

# FILE: tests/test_peripherals.py
================================================================================
from typing import Any, cast
from uuid import UUID

import pytest
from pydantic import BaseModel, ValidationError

from majordom_integration_sdk import (
    AbstractController,
    Endpoint,
    Need,
    NoSettings,
    Peripheral,
    PeripheralChange,
    Peripherals,
    Service,
    UsbDriver,
)
from majordom_integration_sdk.capabilities import BLE_ROUTER
from majordom_integration_sdk.peripherals.peripheral import START_TIMEOUT
from majordom_integration_sdk.schemas.device import Device, Discovery, Parameter
from majordom_integration_sdk.testing import build_test_platform


def test_need_accepts_family_and_dialect():
    assert Need("zigbee").accepts(Endpoint("zigbee", "znp"))
    assert Need("zigbee", ["ezsp", "znp"]).accepts(Endpoint("zigbee", "znp"))
    assert not Need("zigbee", ["ezsp"]).accepts(Endpoint("zigbee", "znp"))
    assert not Need("thread").accepts(Endpoint("zigbee", "ezsp"))


class Host(Peripheral):
    name = "host"
    provides = [Endpoint("ip", is_shared=True)]


async def test_a_peripheral_needs_provides_and_is_bound_nothing_by_default():
    host = Host()
    assert (host.needs, host.provides, host.peripherals.bound) == ((), [Endpoint("ip", is_shared=True)], {})
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        cast(Any, host.peripherals.bound)["ip"] = Endpoint("ip")  # shared by every peripheral until bound: read-only
    assert not host.is_on_demand and host.start_timeout == START_TIMEOUT
    assert host.Settings is NoSettings  # it takes none
    await host.start()
    await host.stop()
    await host.output.peripheral_did_change_provided(host)  # nothing runs it: logged
    assert await host.needed_peripheral_did_change(PeripheralChange("ip", None, None)) is False  # restart it
    assert await host.settings_did_change(NoSettings()) is False
    assert await host.platform_facts_did_change(build_test_platform()) is True  # the facts concern few


def test_peripherals_hand_out_one_endpoint_many_or_an_instance():
    router = object()
    adapters = [Endpoint("ble", "bluez", "hci0"), Endpoint("ble", "bluez", "hci1")]
    peripherals = Peripherals({"zigbee": Endpoint("zigbee", "ezsp", "/dev/ttyUSB0"), "raw": adapters})
    assert peripherals.endpoint("zigbee").url == "/dev/ttyUSB0"
    assert peripherals.endpoints("zigbee") == [peripherals.bound["zigbee"]]
    assert peripherals.endpoints("raw") == adapters
    with pytest.raises(TypeError, match="endpoints"):
        peripherals.endpoint("raw")
    assert peripherals.endpoints("thread") == []
    assert peripherals.instance(BLE_ROUTER) is None
    with pytest.raises(KeyError):
        peripherals.endpoint("thread")

    peripherals = Peripherals({"ble": Endpoint("ble", "router", "router", is_shared=True, instance=router)})
    assert peripherals.instance(BLE_ROUTER) is router


def test_an_endpoint_is_the_same_whatever_instance_it_carries():
    assert Endpoint("ble", "esphome-proxy", "esphome:aa", instance=object()) == Endpoint(
        "ble", "esphome-proxy", "esphome:aa", instance=object()
    )
    assert not Need("ble").is_many


def test_endpoint_params_say_how_to_talk_to_it():
    stick = Endpoint("zigbee", "ezsp", "/dev/ttyUSB0", params={"baud": 115200, "flow_control": True})
    assert stick.params["baud"] == 115200
    assert Endpoint("zigbee").params == {}
    assert hash(stick) == hash(Endpoint("zigbee", "ezsp", "/dev/ttyUSB0"))


SERVER = Service("server", compose={}, provides=[Endpoint("matter", "matter-server", "ws://127.0.0.1:{ports.api}")])


async def test_a_service_runs_on_demand_and_hooks_in_doing_nothing():
    assert SERVER.is_on_demand and SERVER.start_timeout == 30 * 60  # long enough to pull its image first
    assert SERVER.ports == {} and SERVER.Settings is NoSettings
    assert await SERVER.provision(Endpoint("matter", "matter-server", "ws://127.0.0.1:5580")) is None
    assert await SERVER.is_healthy()


async def test_without_a_runtime_a_service_provides_its_templates_and_doesnt_run():
    assert SERVER.provides == SERVER.templates
    with pytest.raises(NotImplementedError, match="run server yourself"):
        await SERVER.start()


class Silabs(UsbDriver):
    name = "silabs"
    firmwares = {"zigbee-ncp": [Endpoint("zigbee", "ezsp", "{device}", params={"baud": 115200})]}


def test_a_usb_driver_says_what_a_firmware_serves_and_offers_itself():
    driver = Silabs()
    assert driver.serves("zigbee-ncp", "/dev/ttyUSB0", {"flow_control": False}) == [
        Endpoint("zigbee", "ezsp", "/dev/ttyUSB0", params={"baud": 115200, "flow_control": False})
    ]
    assert driver.serves(None, "/dev/ttyUSB0") == []
    assert driver.provides[0].instance is driver and driver.is_on_demand
    assert driver.flashable("/dev/ttyUSB0", "dev") == []


class ExampleController(AbstractController[Device, Parameter, "ExampleController.Settings"]):
    needs = [Need("example")]

    class Settings(BaseModel):
        channel: int = 11

    @property
    def discoveries(self) -> dict[UUID, Discovery]:
        return {}

    async def start(self):
        pass

    async def stop(self):
        pass

    async def pair_device(self, discovery, credentials):
        pass

    async def unpair(self, device):
        pass

    async def identify(self, device):
        pass

    async def fetch(self, device):
        pass

    async def send_command(self, command, device, parameter):
        pass


async def test_a_controller_is_a_peripheral_with_its_settings_and_its_peripherals():
    controller = ExampleController(build_test_platform())
    controller.peripherals = Peripherals({"example": Endpoint("example", "echo", "ws://x")})  # library mode
    assert controller.settings.channel == 11  # its defaults until the runtime hands over the saved ones
    assert controller.peripherals.endpoint("example").url == "ws://x"
    assert not controller.is_on_demand and controller.provides == ()
    assert await controller.needed_peripheral_did_change(PeripheralChange("example", None, None)) is False
    assert await controller.platform_facts_did_change(build_test_platform()) is True  # it reads them when it does


def test_a_controller_without_settings_takes_none():
    class Plain(ExampleController):
        Settings = NoSettings

    assert Plain(build_test_platform()).settings == NoSettings()
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        NoSettings.model_validate({"channel": 11})
    assert AbstractController.needs == ()

# FILE: tests/test_repository.py
================================================================================
"""Both first-class repositories must satisfy the same protocol behaviour."""

from uuid import uuid4

import pytest
from factories import make_device_state

from majordom_integration_sdk.repository import (
    DeviceRepositoryMemory,
    DeviceRepositoryProtocol,
    SqliteDeviceRepository,
)
from majordom_integration_sdk.schemas.base import Base
from majordom_integration_sdk.schemas.device import Device, DeviceState
from majordom_integration_sdk.schemas.parameter import ParameterVisibility


class _PairingData(Base):
    """An integration's own typed `integration_data` (e.g. HomeKit pairing data)."""

    token: str


class _Endpoint(Base):
    """A parameter's own typed `integration_data`."""

    endpoint: int


class _Learned(Base):
    """Typed `integration_data` an unpaired device can hold: every field has a default."""

    firmware: str | None = None


class _MyDevice(Device[_PairingData]):
    pass


def make_my_device(device_id=None, token: str = "secret", integration: str = "example") -> _MyDevice:
    return _MyDevice(
        id=device_id or uuid4(),
        name="Lamp",
        room_id=uuid4(),
        transport="wifi",
        integration=integration,
        manufacturer="ACME",
        integration_data=_PairingData(token=token),
    )


@pytest.fixture(params=["memory", "sqlite"])
def repository(request, tmp_path) -> DeviceRepositoryProtocol:
    if request.param == "memory":
        return DeviceRepositoryMemory()
    return SqliteDeviceRepository(tmp_path / "devices.db")


async def test_save_and_read_back(repository, device_state):
    async with repository.session() as repo:
        await repo.save(device_state)

        state = await repo.state(device_state.id)
        got = await repo.get(device_state.id)
        assert state is not None and state.id == device_state.id
        assert got is not None and got.id == device_state.id
        assert [d.id for d in await repo.get_all()] == [device_state.id]


async def test_get_unknown_is_none(repository):
    async with repository.session() as repo:
        assert await repo.state(uuid4()) is None
        assert await repo.get(uuid4()) is None


async def test_parameter_state_round_trip(repository, device_state):
    parameter = device_state.parameters[0]
    async with repository.session() as repo:
        await repo.save(device_state)

        fetched = await repo.get_parameter_state(device_state.id, parameter.id)
        assert fetched is not None and fetched.id == parameter.id

        parameter.value = 7
        await repo.save_parameter_state(device_state.id, parameter)
        updated = await repo.get_parameter_state(device_state.id, parameter.id)
        assert updated is not None and updated.value == 7


async def test_update_visibility(repository, device_state):
    parameter = device_state.parameters[0]
    async with repository.session() as repo:
        await repo.save(device_state)
        await repo.update_parameter_visibility(parameter.id, ParameterVisibility.system)
        fetched = await repo.get_parameter_state(device_state.id, parameter.id)
        assert fetched is not None and fetched.visibility is ParameterVisibility.system


async def test_save_with_previous_id_renames_row(repository):
    provisional = make_device_state(id=uuid4())
    final_id = uuid4()
    async with repository.session() as repo:
        await repo.save(provisional)
        renamed = provisional.model_copy(update={"id": final_id})
        await repo.save(renamed, previous_id=provisional.id)

        assert await repo.state(provisional.id) is None
        renamed_state = await repo.state(final_id)
        assert renamed_state is not None and renamed_state.id == final_id


async def test_delete(repository, device_state):
    async with repository.session() as repo:
        await repo.save(device_state)
        await repo.delete(device_state.id)
        assert await repo.state(device_state.id) is None


async def test_typed_read_returns_typed_integration_data(repository):
    device = make_my_device(token="secret")
    async with repository.session() as repo:
        await repo.save(device)

        got = await repo.get(device.id, as_=_MyDevice)
        assert got is not None
        assert isinstance(got.integration_data, _PairingData)
        assert got.integration_data.token == "secret"

        listed = await repo.get_all(as_=_MyDevice)
        assert [d.integration_data.token for d in listed] == ["secret"]


async def test_a_typed_state_reads_the_data_of_the_device_and_its_parameters(repository, device_state):
    device_state.parameters[0].integration_data = {"endpoint": 1}
    async with repository.session() as repo:
        await repo.save(device_state)
        await repo.save(make_my_device(device_id=device_state.id, integration=device_state.integration))

        state = await repo.state(device_state.id, as_=DeviceState[_PairingData, _Endpoint])
        assert state is not None and state.integration_data.token == "secret"
        assert state.parameters[0].integration_data.endpoint == 1
        untyped = await repo.state(device_state.id)  # a bare name means any data
        assert untyped is not None and untyped.parameters[0].integration_data == {"endpoint": 1}


async def test_device_and_state_views_merge(repository, device_state):
    """Device carries integration_data, DeviceState parameters too — saving one must not clobber the other's half of
    the record, nor a DeviceState that wasn't given integration_data the stored one."""
    device = make_my_device(device_id=device_state.id, token="t", integration=device_state.integration)
    async with repository.session() as repo:
        await repo.save(device_state)  # info + parameters
        await repo.save(device)  # info + integration_data

        state = await repo.state(device_state.id)
        typed = await repo.get(device_state.id, as_=_MyDevice)
        assert state is not None and len(state.parameters) == 1, "parameters must survive a Device save"
        assert typed is not None and typed.integration_data.token == "t"

        # ...and the reverse order.
        await repo.save(device_state)
        typed_again = await repo.get(device_state.id, as_=_MyDevice)
        assert typed_again is not None, "integration_data must survive a DeviceState save"
        assert typed_again.integration_data.token == "t"


async def test_a_typed_state_without_data_holds_its_own_model_and_keeps_the_stored_one(repository, device_state):
    """Built without `integration_data`, a typed device holds its own model validated from `{}`; the field stays unset,
    so saving it leaves the stored data as it is."""
    state = DeviceState[_Learned](**device_state.model_dump(exclude={"integration_data"}))
    assert isinstance(state.integration_data, _Learned)
    async with repository.session() as repo:
        await repo.save(make_my_device(device_id=state.id, token="t", integration=state.integration))
        await repo.save(state)

        typed = await repo.get(state.id, as_=_MyDevice)
        assert typed is not None and typed.integration_data.token == "t"


async def test_data_filled_in_place_on_a_device_saved_without_any_is_kept(repository):
    """Read back from a record without data, a typed device holds its own model, unset; filled in place (a pairing on
    the record the Hub seeded), it is saved: the record has no data to keep."""
    seeded = Device(
        id=uuid4(), name="Lamp", room_id=uuid4(), transport="wifi", integration="example", manufacturer=None
    )
    async with repository.session() as repo:
        await repo.save(seeded)
        device = await repo.get(seeded.id, as_=Device[_Learned])
        assert device is not None
        device.integration_data.firmware = "1.2"
        await repo.save(device)

        kept = await repo.get(seeded.id, as_=Device[_Learned])
        assert kept is not None and kept.integration_data.firmware == "1.2"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("stored", [{}, None])
async def test_data_filled_in_place_on_a_state_saved_onto_a_record_holding_none_is_kept(repository, stored):
    """The `{}` (or null) the Hub stores a device with before pairing is no data to keep: a typed state built without
    any and filled in place (a pairing) is saved, as the Hub's own repository does."""
    seeded = Device(
        id=uuid4(), name="Lamp", room_id=uuid4(), transport="wifi", integration="example", manufacturer=None,
        integration_data=stored,
    )  # fmt: skip
    async with repository.session() as repo:
        await repo.save(seeded)
        state = DeviceState[_Learned](**seeded.model_dump(exclude={"integration_data"}), parameters=[])
        state.integration_data.firmware = "1.2"
        await repo.save(state)

        kept = await repo.get(seeded.id, as_=Device[_Learned])
        assert kept is not None and kept.integration_data.firmware == "1.2"


def test_optional_data_is_none_until_paired(device_state):
    """`Device[X | None]`: unset, or the `{}` the Hub stores a device with before pairing, is None."""
    optional = DeviceState[_PairingData | None]
    assert optional(**device_state.model_dump(exclude={"integration_data"})).integration_data is None
    assert optional(**device_state.model_dump()).integration_data is None


@pytest.fixture(params=["memory", "sqlite"])
def make_scoped(request, tmp_path):
    """Factory building repositories that share one backing store, scoped per call."""
    store: dict = {}
    path = tmp_path / "scoped.db"

    def make(integration):
        if request.param == "memory":
            return DeviceRepositoryMemory(integration=integration, store=store)
        return SqliteDeviceRepository(path, integration=integration)

    return make


async def test_scope_limits_get_all(make_scoped):
    admin = make_scoped(None)  # full access
    async with admin.session() as repo:
        await repo.save(make_device_state(integration="mine"))
        await repo.save(make_device_state(integration="other"))

    async with make_scoped("mine").session() as repo:
        assert {d.integration for d in await repo.get_all()} == {"mine"}
    async with make_scoped(None).session() as repo:
        assert {d.integration for d in await repo.get_all()} == {"mine", "other"}


async def test_scope_rejects_foreign_save(make_scoped):
    async with make_scoped("mine").session() as repo:
        with pytest.raises(PermissionError):
            await repo.save(make_device_state(integration="other"))


async def test_scope_hides_foreign_reads(make_scoped):
    foreign = make_device_state(integration="other")
    async with make_scoped(None).session() as repo:
        await repo.save(foreign)
    async with make_scoped("mine").session() as repo:
        assert await repo.state(foreign.id) is None
        assert await repo.get(foreign.id) is None
        assert await repo.get_parameter_state(foreign.id, foreign.parameters[0].id) is None


async def test_sqlite_persists_across_sessions(tmp_path, device_state):
    repo = SqliteDeviceRepository(tmp_path / "devices.db")
    async with repo.session() as session:
        await session.save(device_state)
    # A brand-new repository object over the same file still sees the device.
    reopened = SqliteDeviceRepository(tmp_path / "devices.db")
    async with reopened.session() as session:
        persisted = await session.state(device_state.id)
        assert persisted is not None and persisted.id == device_state.id

# FILE: tests/test_schemas.py
================================================================================
"""Schema behaviour that the SDK owns — pythonic parameter values, generic over the value type V."""

from uuid import uuid4

from majordom_integration_sdk.schemas.parameter import (
    ParameterDataType,
    ParameterRole,
    ParameterState,
    ParameterVisibility,
)


def _state(data_type: ParameterDataType, **kw) -> ParameterState:
    return ParameterState(
        id=uuid4(),
        name="p",
        data_type=data_type,
        role=ParameterRole.control,
        visibility=ParameterVisibility.user,
        integration_data=None,
        **kw,
    )


def test_scalar_value_is_pythonic_and_roundtrips():
    for dt, v in [
        (ParameterDataType.integer, 5),
        (ParameterDataType.bool, True),
        (ParameterDataType.decimal, 1.5),
        (ParameterDataType.string, "hi"),
    ]:
        s = _state(dt, value=v)
        assert s.value == v
        assert ParameterState.model_validate_json(s.model_dump_json()).value == v


def test_struct_value_is_a_plain_dict():
    s = _state(ParameterDataType.struct, value={"a": 1, "b": [2, 3]})
    assert s.value == {"a": 1, "b": [2, 3]}
    assert ParameterState.model_validate_json(s.model_dump_json()).value == {"a": 1, "b": [2, 3]}


def test_value_valid_values_and_default_share_one_type():
    # An int parameter: int value, int valid_values keys, int default_value — all V=int.
    s = _state(ParameterDataType.enum, value=0, valid_values={0: "off", 4: "on"}, default_value={0, 4})
    assert (s.value, s.valid_values, s.default_value) == (0, {0: "off", 4: "on"}, {0, 4})

    rt = ParameterState.model_validate_json(s.model_dump_json())
    assert rt.default_value == {0, 4}  # a set survives the JSON-array round-trip
    assert rt.valid_values == {0: "off", 4: "on"}  # int keys survive


def test_single_default_value_stays_scalar():
    s = _state(ParameterDataType.integer, default_value=5)
    assert s.default_value == 5  # a lone value is the scalar branch of `set[V] | V`, not a set


def test_a_parameter_compares_with_other_values_without_raising():
    """Its equality is by id among parameters; anything else (a stored raw value, as an ORM compares it) is unequal."""
    parameter = _state(ParameterDataType.integer, value=7)

    assert parameter == parameter.model_copy(update={"value": 8})
    assert parameter != 7


================================================================================
# FILE: tests/test_spec_drift.py
================================================================================
from majordom_integration_sdk.spec_drift import diff_specs


def test_detects_each_tier():
    baseline = {(1, 1): "user", (1, 2): "setting", (1, 3): "system"}
    current = {(1, 1): "user", (1, 2): "user", (1, 4): "setting"}  # 1,2 reclassified; 1,3 removed; 1,4 added
    r = diff_specs(current, baseline)
    assert r.added == {(1, 4): "setting"}
    assert r.removed == {(1, 3): "system"}
    assert r.reclassified == {(1, 2): ("setting", "user")}


def test_reclassify_is_high_risk():
    r = diff_specs({(1, 1): "user"}, {(1, 1): "setting"})
    assert r.has_high_risk
    assert not r.is_empty


def test_add_only_is_not_high_risk():
    r = diff_specs({(1, 1): "user", (2, 2): "setting"}, {(1, 1): "user"})
    assert not r.has_high_risk
    assert r.added == {(2, 2): "setting"}


def test_identical_is_empty():
    spec = {(1, 1): "user"}
    r = diff_specs(spec, dict(spec))
    assert r.is_empty
    assert "no drift" in r.render(source="zha")


def test_render_lists_reclassify_first():
    r = diff_specs({(1, 1): "user", (9, 9): "user"}, {(1, 1): "setting"})
    out = r.render(source="zha")
    assert out.index("RECLASSIFY") < out.index("ADD")


def test_render_key_label_annotates_each_change():
    r = diff_specs({(0x0556, 1): "user"}, {})
    out = r.render(source="matter-ha", key_label=lambda k: f"Chime.Attr{k[1]}")
    # the human name appears alongside the raw id on the change line
    assert "Chime.Attr1" in out
    assert "(1366, 1)" in out


def test_render_key_label_failure_falls_back_to_id():
    def boom(_key: object) -> str:
        raise KeyError("unknown")

    r = diff_specs({(0x0556, 1): "user"}, {})
    out = r.render(source="matter-ha", key_label=boom)  # must not raise
    assert "(1366, 1)" in out

from importlib.metadata import version

import majordom_integration_sdk


def test_version_matches_installed_distribution():
    assert majordom_integration_sdk.__version__ == version("majordom-integration-sdk")
